pre_cruise: Arrive a day early and Galveston gives you a real port town to explore. The Strand Historic District downtown is a National Historic Landmark of Victorian buildings from the island's 19th century shipping era, now lined with shops and galleries. The Texas Seaport Museum tells the maritime story and includes Elissa, a 19th century tall ship you can tour. On the seawall side, the Galveston Island Historic Pleasure Pier puts amusement rides and carnival games right over the Gulf. For beach time, East Beach is the lively pick while Galveston Island State Park offers more than 2,000 acres of sand, marsh and trails, and Moody Gardens adds an aquarium and a rainforest pyramid for families.
